decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than five residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate surroundings

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Within six months of the date of this permission, waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers shall have been provided on site, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities are to be retained thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets

Within six months of the date of this permission, five long stay cycle parking spaces to satisfy the permitted number of occupiers on site shall have been fully provided. The dedicated cycle store providing five long stay parking spaces shall fulfil the following criteria: Location: Near entrances or main access, Design: Stands, Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit, Fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof, Accessibility: 1.2m wide, Step-free, no obstructions.Cycle parking shall be retained on site thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

The existing building(s) shall not be used as ancillary accommodation, sleeping accommodation or as a separate residential unit at any time. The accommodation shall remain incidental to the use of the main dwelling/approved HMO. Reason: To prevent the creation of an independent unit of occupation and to avoid any intensified use of the site as an HMO, in the interests of proper planning and protecting residential amenity.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the flood risk mitigation measures set out in the Flood Risk Assessment, including internal finished floor levels maintained between 20cm and 38cm above external ground levels, and the use of the proposed flood resistance and resilience measures (such as air vent covers and demountable barriers including sandbags, hydro-sacks, or steel door barriers) as necessary. The finished floor levels and all mitigation measures shall be retained and maintained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure the development is appropriately protected from flood risk and to comply with Policies DMD 59 and DMD 60 and the NPPF 2024.
